description: This file defines an actor class `PortGuardian` responsible for managing and monitoring network ports, including recording port usage, killing processes listening on specific ports, and diagnosing port statuses. It interacts with system utilities like `lsof` and `ps` to gather information about network listeners, and manages port records stored in a JSON file. The class encapsulates methods for port sweeping, diagnostics, and recording, tailored specifically for a macOS environment.

classes.name: PortGuardian
classes.description: An actor that manages port records, monitors active listeners on network ports, and performs actions such as sweeping ports and diagnosing their statuses.

methods.name: sweep
methods.description: Performs a port sweep based on the current connection mode, killing unexpected listeners.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records details of a port and process, saving to a JSON file.

methods.name: removeRecord
methods.description: Removes port process record based on process ID.

methods.name: diagnose
methods.description: Returns a list of port reports with their current status and listeners.

methods.name: probeGatewayHealth
methods.description: Checks health of the gateway on a specified port.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Provides a descriptor for a given port, including process info.
